codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.familiar_fox_pur:
‘The unstable holy golden apple seems unable to dispel the curse from your body,
The curse afflicting you is far more stubborn than imagined.
However, fortunately, it has purged the witch’s magic from you.’
Yet, the physical alterations made by the witch’s magic cannot be reverted.

You appear largely identical to an ordinary wild red fox—except for the two large tails swaying unusually behind you.
Your eyes are now unmistakably those of a wild animal. In sunlight, your pupils contract into narrow slits.
You realize the nature of the magic within you has completely changed. The witch’s mana has been purged, and the abilities it granted vanished along with it.
Your body is now filled with a special type of mana. The potency of your abilities is proportional to the amount of this special mana.
Blue-green flames occasionally manifest around your body before slowly fading. It seems your new mana is affecting your surroundings.

It appears this will be your new life from now on.

New mana surges within you. You have fully mastered how to utilize your mana reserves...
Your mana attaches to your weapon when attacking, consuming mana proportionally to deal additional damage.
Your mana forms a protective shield around you, granting extra armor and consuming mana when injured to mitigate part of the damage.
Your mana protects you from fire damage. While in fire or lava, your mana will be continuously consumed to maintain this effect.
Your mana allows you to consume it when hungry to restore satiety.
You can restore mana by defeating mobs or consuming golden food.
Your mana mildly repels other magics; Instant Health and Instant Damage effects are reduced to 1/4 effectiveness.
Your running speed is increased. Due to your size, ranged attacks also have difficulty hitting you.
You can now stack up to 8 identical potions.
When your mana is above 1/2, upon taking fatal damage, consume mana to avoid death.
Thanks to your thick fur, you can move freely through sweet berry bushes.

All your power is derived from mana; you must maintain a sufficient mana reserve at all times:
When your mana is completely depleted, you enter Exhaustion Mode.
While in Exhaustion Mode, you gain Weakness and Slowness effects, your hunger consumption quadruples, and you take continuous damage.
While in Exhaustion Mode, most of your mana skills cannot be used due to lack of mana.
When your mana recovers to 1/5, you exit Exhaustion Mode.

Due to heavy reliance on mana, your physical strength is relatively weak.
Since you have expelled the witch’s mana, illagers will now be hostile toward you.

You have less health. Without hands capable of freely using tools, your block-breaking speed is also slower.
Leggings and boots no longer suit your quadrupedal body structure, and your movement speed in water is reduced.

Press the Active Ability (2) key to toggle mana intensity. Higher intensity increases your power but also raises consumption.
Fox Fireball: While holding a stick, consume a small amount of mana. Press the right-click button to fire a straight-traveling fireball, dealing damage and igniting the target.
Fox Fireball EX: While holding a talisman, consume a large amount of mana. Press the right-click button to fire a straight-traveling fireball, dealing heavy damage and causing a large explosion (does not destroy blocks).
Fox Fire Arrow: While holding an arrow, consume a moderate amount of mana. Press the right-click button to fire a straight-traveling fire arrow, dealing heavy damage and igniting the target.
Fox Fire Ring: Press the Active Ability (1) key, consume a large amount of mana to release a ring of fire that slowly expands from your center, dealing damage, knocking back, and igniting targets within range.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.unstable_holy_: The Unstable Holy Golden Apple has produced a special reaction with your form; you have transformed into a new form.
You are fortunate. Before your curse could affect the Holy Golden Apple, its magic restored your original form. However, the curse remains unbroken and continues to affect you.
Your curse caused the Unstable Holy Golden Apple's magic to become even more volatile. It exploded violently in your hands. Perhaps a stable Holy Apple could restore your form?
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.stable_holy_ap: The Holy Golden Apple's magic has restored your form, but the curse remains unbroken and continues to affect you.
item.ssc_xu_addon.mana_boost_bracelet.to: [Familiar Fox Purify Form] Increases your mana capacity and mana regeneration.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.name: Bat (Vampire)
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.titl: Because of that strange gem, a fervent thirst for blood now courses through your veins..
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.equi: [Blood Amulet],[Blood Rage Gauntlets],[Sunveil Circlet],[Anchoring Grappling Hook],[Diamond Grip Claws],[Blood Claws]
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.appe:
That mysterious gem has wrought changes to your body.
Fine, dense fur completely covers your body. Ears nearly as large as your head help you locate your surroundings, ensuring you don't miss even the faintest sounds around you.
Your forelimbs have extended further to make space for the massive membrane wings. If you wish, you could wrap your entire body within these wings.
Fore claws and hind paws equipped with hooks allow you to cling to walls or hang upside-down from cave ceilings, just like your kind.
Your body is now fully specialized for flight and gliding. Your hind legs can no longer support your body weight, forcing you to move slowly on the ground in a near-quadrupedal stance.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.pros:
When your Blood Resource Bar is above 1/5, you will feel no hunger, and you can convert blood to restore your saturation.
Your skin has also changed because of the gem—you are immune to instant damage and instant healing effects, and gain 4/5 resistance to magical damage.
When your Blood Resource Bar is above 1/2, taking fatal damage will consume 3/10 of your blood to unleash Blood Step and escape in an emergency.
You can restore your Blood Resource Bar by slaying creatures, with the restoration amount based on the creature's health.
Hitting a target with Bloodsucking Long Claws restores your Blood Resource Bar and a small amount of health.
Newly formed hooks grant you the ability to cling and hang upside-down.
Massive membrane wings enable you to glide swiftly through the air.
You can now clearly discern things in darkness.
Hardened and powerful fore claws enhance your melee damage. Additionally, they allow you to dig blocks at high speed barehanded and harvest drops normally.
By flapping your wing membranes, you can jump higher and descend slowly from heights. Naturally, they can also serve as elytra.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.cons:
Because of the gem, you can no longer consume non-gilded food.
Your body craves blood with an overwhelming urgency—when your Blood Resource Bar falls below 1/10, it will automatically consume your health to restore blood. The lower your blood resource, the faster the conversion speed, and the conversion efficiency diminishes more and more.Due to the shift in your center of gravity, you can now only move slowly on the ground in a nearly quadrupedal posture.
Sunlight now poses a fatal threat to you. Under sunlight, you take 1 point of damage every 2 seconds, suffer from Weakness, your Blood Resource Bar depletes twice as fast, take 1.5x additional damage, and the enhanced melee damage effect cannot be sustained.
Your new skin seems extremely vulnerable to fire—you take double damage from fire sources.
Your fore claws are no longer suited for grasping bulky tools and weapons. When you use them to dig hard blocks or swing them to hit monsters, they will merely slip off and drop. Naturally, you can also no longer operate bows or crossbows.
Your membrane wings and digitigrade leg structure make equipping chestplates, leggings, and boots impossible.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.bat_vampire.inst:
Press Active Ability (1) to unleash Blood Spikes, firing 5 blood spikes at the target your gaze is locked on. Hitting a target restores your Blood Resource Bar and health, deals minor damage, and bypasses invincibility frames.
Press Active Ability (2) to unleash Blood Step, teleporting to the location you point to, gaining Weakness and Invisibility, and causing nearby enemies to lose their target.
Using a Blood Gem restores 1/5 of your health and 1/2 of your Blood Resource Bar.
While airborne, you can right-click 'use' the side face of a block while empty-handed to cling to it. While clinging, press jump while aiming in a direction to kick off for a high-speed glide in that direction.
While airborne, you can right-click 'use' the underside of a block while empty-handed to hang yourself upside-down from it. While hanging upside-down, your health will slowly regenerate.
While flying, you can press the sprint key to consume your Blood Resource Bar and activate flight boost.
Press the sneak key to activate Blood Sense, highlighting nearby mobs and doubling damage dealt by arrows.
item.ssc_xu_addon.charm_of_blood.tooltip: [Bat (Vampire) Form] Increases Blood Resource Bar cap, reduces natural Blood Resource depletion rate.
item.ssc_xu_addon.bloodrage_gauntlets.to: [Bat (Vampire) Form] Consume a Blood Gem to unleash Blood Rage, boost your own abilities, and restore Blood Resource and HP on hit.
item.ssc_xu_addon.sunveil_circlet.toolti: [Bat (Vampire) Form] Removes negative effects under sunlight, but Blood Resource depletion rate remains doubled.
item.ssc_xu_addon.blood_claw.tooltip: [Bat (Vampire) Form] Restore Blood Resource and HP on hit, and accumulate Blood to forge a Blood Gem.
item.ssc_xu_addon.blood_gem.tooltip.1: A strange power resides within this gem; crushing it should temporarily boost your abilities.
item.ssc_xu_addon.blood_gem.tooltip.2: Can be found in Nether Fortresses and Ruined Portals.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.blood_gem.spec: The Blood Gem has reacted uniquely with your form, transmuting you into a new shape.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.feral_cat_vf.tit: By absorbing the magic within Emerald Essence, emeralds have grown upon your body, and villagers now adore you.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.feral_cat_vf.app:
Your body has transformed into an elegant black cat, with fur as smooth as night and eyes gleaming with intelligence.
The essence of emeralds has merged with you. Several small, uncut natural emerald crystals, like growing scales or gem clusters, now adorn your body.
Your hind limb structure is specialized for agility and lightness, allowing you to land silently and move deftly, but preventing you from wearing conventional leggings or boots.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.feral_cat_vf.pro:
You radiate an aura that reassures villages, granting a permanent Hero of the Village II effect and significant discounts with villagers
You are protected by village Iron Golems; other players attacking you is treated as attacking a villager
You periodically and passively improve the reputation of nearby villagers (effect diminishes with distance)
Due to a cat's eyes, you now possess a degree of Night Vision
Your light body makes you immune to fall damage, allows you to move silently, and significantly enhances your jumping ability
You've learned some alchemy from witches. You can now brew certain potions quickly and can stack up to 8 identical potions
Due to your current appearance, cat-phobic Creepers and Phantoms will not initiate attacks against you
When you would take fatal damage, you consume 50% of your max health (for 10 minutes) to avoid death. This effect has a 10-minute cooldown
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.feral_cat_vf.con:
As your claws are less suited for digging, your mining speed is relatively slow
Contact with water causes you great discomfort, reducing your mining and attack speed, and lowering your melee damage
The structure of your hind limbs prevents you from wearing any leggings or boots
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.feral_cat_vf.ins:
Compared to other forms, you notice this one seems "special": it barely affects your mind and feels less stable. If desired, you could likely revert it relatively easily



Press Active Ability (1) to refresh the trades of nearby villagers and gain trading reputation
Press Active Ability (2) to produce emeralds from your body, with a small chance to yield diamonds (consumes health to reduce cooldown)
Use Emerald Essence to summon an Iron Golem, turning yourself invisible for 15 seconds and clearing nearby hostility
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.emerald_essenc: You have absorbed the magic within the Emerald Essence, and the power contained within it has transformed you into a new form.
item.ssc_xu_addon.emerald_essence.toolti: Crafted from the concentrated magic within vast amounts of emeralds. Some forms seem capable of casting spells with it. Breaking it appears to yield some emeralds.
item.ssc_xu_addon.charm_of_emerald.toolt: [Cat (Village Friend) Form] Improves villager discount rates (increases Hero of the Village effect).
item.ssc_xu_addon.anklet_of_the_witch_fa: [Cat (Village Friend) Form] The magic on this trinket causes pillagers to mistake you for a witch's familiar, making them neutral. However, if you initiate an attack, pillagers will see through the ruse.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.allay_engineer.t: You now closely resemble a friendly spectral creature, though unclear if due to internal magic, you exhibit some unique features
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.allay_engineer.a:
Your body now consists of light blue translucent gauze-like substance. Extremely light, letting you float
The Space Gem that transformed you is embedded in your body. Activating its power lets you phase through almost all blocks.
Feathery antenna-like structures grow from your forehead - very flexible. They grant new senses detecting nearby creatures' locations
Branch-like wings sprout from your back. With them, you can hover through skies. Below wings, two ribbon-like extensions emerge - purpose unclear, possibly compensating lost leg functions
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.allay_engineer.p:
Your more spectral physique grants new abilities -
You no longer need to eat, as the Space Gem slowly absorbs energy from another dimension.
Holding jump lets you ascend and hover freely midair. You also descend slowly

Floating means no footsteps
Amethyst resonates strangely with you: in inventory, you can "use" one amethyst block on another to create amethyst shards
You sense other creatures' energy: detecting entities within range. Damaging others lets you siphon some health
Enhanced perception increases bow damage
Your tiny size lets you enter 1-block spaces easily, and projectiles miss you more often
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.allay_engineer.c:
The Space Gem also comes with side effects -
Flying or using spatial abilities increases your Phasing Value. The higher your Phasing Value, the lower your melee damage, but the higher your damage reduction.
When your Phasing Value exceeds 85/100, you take continuous Void damage. When full, you take a large amount of Void damage at once.
Your body can't derive energy from food - only amethyst shards restore satiation. You also heal less from satiation
Your weaker body requires both hands for tools/weapons. You break hard materials slower and deal reduced melee damage. Your max health has reduced greatly either
Floating increases inertia, making stopping harder
Your lower torso vanished - you can't wear leggings or boots
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.allay_engineer.i:
Compared to other forms, you sense something 'special' about your current form: it does not affect your mind much, nor is it fully stable. If you wish, you should be able to reverse it relatively easily.



Press Active Ability (1) to initiate a warp. When Phasing is active, you can pass through blocks, but using spatial energy will slightly increase your Phasing Value.
Press Active Ability (2) to activate Phasing, allowing you to pass through all blocks, but continuously increasing your Phasing Value. While inside blocks, you can only see using the unique organs you gained during your Allay phase (similar to Blindness).
Press Active Ability (5) to open a player-bound storage space, sharing the Space Gem's dimension. Using a Space Gem unlocks a larger space.
item.ssc_xu_addon.space_gem.tooltip: An unstable Space Gem. Using it seems to open a rift to another plane, though the location may be uncertain. That plane appears to only store items.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.space_gem.spec: The Space Gem suddenly fuses with your body, transforming you into a new form.
item.ssc_xu_addon.stable_space_gem.toolt: A stabilized Space Gem that opens a stable dimensional rift. Sneak-use to access Ender Chest space, but it loses the ability to travel to other locations.
item.ssc_xu_addon.space_bag.tooltip: A storage pouch made with Space Gem, stabilized with gold and lapis lazuli.
item.ssc_xu_addon.space_stabilizer.toolt: [Allay (Spatial Engineer) Form] A Space Gem stabilized with gold and lapis lazuli. Its energy stabilizes the Space Gem in your body, restores some maximum health, increases the Phasing Value cap, increases Phasing Value consumption rate, and reduces Phasing ability costs.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.ocelot_jungle.ti: You have absorbed the magic of the Wind Gem, granting you unparalleled speed.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.ocelot_jungle.eq: [Charm of Wind],[Heavy Bracelet],[Vitality Stone],[Digestion Fiber Ball]
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.ocelot_jungle.ap:
Apart from your fur color, body size and the markings, you're nearly indistinguishable from a wild ocelot
You're the apex predator of the dense jungle. With your keen eyes and razor-sharp claws, every creature is potential prey
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.ocelot_jungle.pr:
Your body has fully adapted to quadrupedal structure, significantly enhancing your leaping ability. 
Your strengthened claws allow climbing on nearly any surface
You can harness the power of wind to boost your speed. The longer you sprint, the faster you become. While sprinting, you can automatically step over one-block-high blocks.
Attacking while sprinting deals extra damage and knockback. The faster you are, the higher the damage.
Your keen senses let you instinctively dodge incoming projectiles (when stamina is above 3/4)
Night vision grants perfect sight in darkness
You can deal heavy damage with your bare forepaws and apply Poison.
You can now trigger sweeping attacks even without a sword
You produce no footstep sounds and take no fall damage
Fresh raw meat provides greater satiation
Your physiology grants strong immunity to both hunger and poison effects
Creepers and Phantoms will actively avoid you
You can automatically consume meat-based food from the "extra hand" slot.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.ocelot_jungle.co:
Your power comes from physical bursts and is limited by your Stamina.
Sprinting and attacking consume Stamina. When Stamina is depleted, you enter Exhaustion, during which most of your abilities cannot be triggered.
Armor is reduced by 1/5. When your Stamina falls below 4/10, you take extra damage. The lower your Stamina, the higher the extra damage.
Your altered digestive system can no longer get energy from non-raw meat foods.
Any armor severely hinders your movement. You can now only wear helmets and cannot properly use shields
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.ocelot_jungle.in:
Press Active Ability (1) to trigger Offensive Rush, consuming a large amount of Stamina. Leap toward your target, creating a small explosion mid-air and a large explosion upon landing.

Press Active Ability (2) to trigger Defensive Blink, consuming all Stamina. Teleport 64 blocks away, gain Invisibility and extra Speed, but cannot attack for 15s.

Sprint for 6s, then press jump to trigger Pounce, dealing massive damage to enemies in front of you.
item.ssc_xu_addon.wind_gem.tooltip.1: A strange power resides within this gem; crushing it should temporarily boost your abilities.
item.ssc_xu_addon.wind_gem.tooltip.2: Can be found in Jungle Temples.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.wind_gem.speci: You have absorbed the magic of the Wind Gem, transforming into a new form.
item.ssc_xu_addon.charm_of_wind.tooltip: [Ocelot (Jungle Assassin) Form] Grants +15 max Stamina, increases Stamina recovery by 1/10, and increases sprint speed gain rate.
item.ssc_xu_addon.heavy_bracelet.tooltip: [Ocelot (Jungle Assassin) Form] Reduces sprint speed, increases sprint attack damage ratio, and reduces slowdown from sprint attacks.
item.ssc_xu_addon.vitality_stone.tooltip: [Ocelot (Jungle Assassin) Form] Increases maximum health by 4, grants 15 extra maximum stamina, and increases stamina regeneration rate by 10%.
item.ssc_xu_addon.fire_gem.tooltip: A gem wrapped in magical energy, allowing it to reclaim burning energy to keep itself perpetually ablaze. Absorbing its power should grant a temporary boost in strength and provide immunity to fire.
item.ssc_xu_addon.ground_gem.tooltip.1: A strange rock coated in soil, its interior brimming with earthen magic. Absorbing it should enhance your defensive capabilities.
item.ssc_xu_addon.ground_gem.tooltip.2: It might be found in underground mineshafts or buried treasure.
item.ssc_xu_addon.water_gem.tooltip: Vast water magic is preserved within this gold in a mysterious manner. Absorbing it grants temporary water breathing and forms a watery membrane around you, granting fire immunity. The magic within the membrane also provides a steady healing effect.
item.ssc_xu_addon.water_gem.tooltip.2: It might be found in ocean ruins or buried treasure.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.super_holy_app: The curse upon you has been lifted by the magic of the Super Holy Apple. However, after purging such a potent curse, little of the apple's magic remains.
You do not have the Moon Curse on you; the Super Holy Golden Apple has no effect on you.

The Super Holy Apple's magic was insufficient to purge the curse intertwined with your transformation magic. The conflicting forces caused a massive explosion. Perhaps you should revert to your original form with a Holy Golden Apple before attempting to remove the curse?
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.tooltip.1: A conch that drifted in from another world. Using it will provide a random hint.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.tooltip.2: It might be found in buried treasure.
item.ssc_xu_addon.charm_of_nine_live.too: Forged from the magic born of the tale that cats have nine lives. This trinket can prevent death nine times. Cooldown: 5 minutes.
A trinket crafted with a Blood Gem. Its magic greatly enhances your offensive abilities at the cost of significantly reducing your defenses.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.1: Using 4 gold blocks, 4 Moondust Crystal Shards, and a golden apple can create a Holy Golden Apple capable of purifying your form. The Familiar Fox form might have a special reaction when consumed during a cursed moon. However, it is unstable; using 8 gold blocks stabilizes it.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.2: You can find crimson gems in chests within Nether Fortresses and Ruined Portals. The ultimate form of the bat may be able to evolve further.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.3: A gem hidden within Jungle Temples can grant the Ocelot new power.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.4: Using 4 emerald blocks, 4 gold ingots, and a Moondust Crystal Shard can create an emerald infused with special magic. The Cat SP form might be able to absorb it.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.5: Legend says you can craft a gem of spatial magic by surrounding a diamond with 4 popped chorus fruits and 4 ender pearls. The Allay form may have a unique reaction to this gem.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.6: Due to its unstable nature, using the Space Gem might reveal lost treasures. However, stabilizing it removes this capability.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.7: Rumors speak of a next stage for the stable Holy Golden Apple. Using the four elemental gems—Water, Fire, Earth, and Wind—combined with the power of 4 nether stars, should allow the Holy Golden Apple to evolve.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.8: The ultimate Holy Golden Apple is said to be able to remove the curse of transformation, but only when in your original form.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.9: It is said that a cat might carry a trinket that can prevent death. Hard to know if the tale is true.
item.ssc_xu_addon.magic_conch.message.10: The magic of the Space Gem might allow the Allay, who already possesses spatial abilities, to create even larger storage spaces.
item.ssc_xu_addon.sea_blessed_ring.toolt: [Axolotl (Sea Prince) Form] Grants additional Water Magic capacity (+25%) and increased Water Magic regeneration while in water (+10/s).
item.ssc_xu_addon.moisture_kept_charm.to: [Axolotl (Sea Prince) Form] When Water Magic is below 95%, consumes its own charge to restore Water Magic at 3 points per second. Automatically charges when the wearer is submerged in water.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.water_gem.spec: You absorb the magic from the Water Gem and transform into a new form.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.axolotl_sea_king: You have absorbed the magic from the Water Gem and learned to harness the water magic of nature. However, due to overuse of water magic, you fall into a weakened state when lacking magic.

You have embedded some Water Gems on your body to enhance water magic.
The further-grown tail has become the main structure of your body, adorned with developed fin membranes that allow swift underwater movement.
Your blunt-clawed limbs have grown even shorter and are now positioned more toward the front of your torso. When standing still, you can only maintain an upright posture with the support of your tail.
Your skin is now entirely covered in pale, scale-less tissue. Thanks to the water-storing feathery structure, your skin remains perpetually moist.

Two new clusters of gill filaments extend from the top of your head. Beyond supplying vital oxygen, you sense they grant you some power to perceive and manipulate water currents...

You now have a Water Magic bar, which can be replenished by submerging in water, or consuming water bottles or any potions.

You can breathe freely underwater, and your body grants hydrokinetic abilities:
While sprinting, you enter 'Wave-Step' state: speed increases and you can automatically step up 1-block heights, but turning becomes harder.
While in 'Wave-Step', you can expend Water Magic to channel water-based powers:
Press Active Skill (1): When not holding the Sea King Scepter, release a large-area water explosion. When holding it, release [Water Spike] – dash forward, triggering small water explosions during flight and a large water explosion upon landing.
Press Active Skill (3): Release [Water Shaping]. When not holding the Sea King Scepter, obtain a virtual Sea King Scepter that cannot be charged. When holding it, overcharge the scepter. When the scepter's charge exceeds its limit, attacks deal additional magic damage. You can also right-click to summon a water trident, causing a medium water explosion at the target location. When holding the virtual scepter, detonate it to cause a large water explosion.
Expend a small amount of Water Magic to press the jump key to propel yourself forward with a water current.
Expend a moderate amount of Water Magic to knock enemies back greatly with your attacks.
Expend a larger amount of Water Magic to press the Active Skill (2) key to release a small-area water explosion. This effect does not break blocks.

You move very swiftly in water currents. When fully submerged, you automatically enter sprint-swimming mode and no longer consume extra hunger.
You do not sink underwater. Press the sprint key to propel yourself forward while in water.
When surfacing, you can leap out of the water.
You can see more clearly underwater and break blocks without hindrance.
When you have Water Magic, you regenerate lost health over time.
While sneaking, you enter a natural crawling stance, allowing you to quickly pass through narrow spaces.
Raw fish provides more hunger saturation.

Your body structure is no longer suited for normal walking. When not in 'Wave-Step' state, your movement becomes quite sluggish.
Water Magic is the source of your strength. Your maximum health decreases as your Water Magic drops; when Water Magic is depleted, you cannot support your body's weight and can only crawl slowly on the ground.
Due to long-term over-reliance on magic, your body is quite frail, taking 75% more damage. However, when your Water Magic is above 30%, your body automatically consumes Water Magic to offset this extra damage.
When your Water Magic falls below 20%, 10%, and 5%, your attack power gradually decreases, and your hunger consumption increases accordingly.
When your Water Magic reaches zero, you will continuously take suffocation damage.

You can no longer equip helmets.
You move slower on loose, powdery ground.
You can only gain energy from meat-based foods.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.spider_undead.ti: You have absorbed the power of the Undead Essence, fusing your spider form with undead energy. Your carapace is now clad in bony armour, and rotting flesh intertwines with silk—the authority of the Undead Matriarch is yours.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.spider_undead.eq: [Swarmbond Amulet], [Undead Ring], [Auxiliary Sword], [Auxiliary Pickaxe], [Auxiliary Axe], [Shield (Extra Arm Slot)], [Nutrient Sac (Extra Arm Slot)], [Venom Spindle]
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.spider_undead.ap:
Your body retains the basic structure of a spider, but your six limbs and enlarged abdomen are now covered in pale bony exoskeleton, as if armour has grown from within.
Dark green, rotting flesh peeks through the gaps in the exoskeleton, exuding a faint undead aura that mingles with dried silk glands.
Your four pairs of compound eyes have turned deep red, like bloody stars in the darkness, sending chills down the spine of any who meet your gaze.
Your body is covered in patterns of undead power interwoven with web-like textures, fully displaying the majesty of the Undead Matriarch.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.spider_undead.pr:
You possess a Web Value resource bar that regenerates over time. You can also replenish it by slaying creatures or consuming string.

Hold Active Skill (1) to charge and fire a web projectile. Hitting the side or bottom of a block creates a vertical bridge web. Hitting a creature applies Slowness, Weakness, and the 'Entangled' effect (which accumulates into 'Cocooned', immobilizing the target). While sneaking, creates a horizontal web bridge, with its length and width scaling with charge level.
Hold Active Skill (2) to charge and create a web bridge. Its length and width scale with charge level.
Press Active Ability (3) to consume Web Value and satiation (one summon per 4 points of satiation) to summon small spiders to fight for you, up to 2 at a time, while keeping at least 6 satiation. When these spiders die, they spread Entangled to nearby creatures.

Your attacks deal 2 extra damage to creatures with Entangled; if the target is Cocooned, your attacks heal you for 2 HP and restore some Web Value.
The undead power within your body allows you to cheat death: cooldown 2 minutes. When triggered, you gain Invisibility and spawn 4 small spiders.
When you have summons, damage dealt to you is transferred to them: one summon is randomly chosen to take damage equal to 2× the incoming damage (before armour); if it dies, the remainder is passed to the next, until all are dead or the damage is exhausted.

You possess an extra pair of arms. By equipping different special items in the Trinkets extra hand slot, you gain various benefits.
You can eat string to replenish Web Value. While holding string in your inventory, right‑click it on another string to craft cobwebs at a small Web Value cost.
While holding a cobweb, right‑click a composter to create a Nutrient Dissolve Cocoon—place meat inside to gradually turn it into Nutrient Sacs you can consume.
Your fully transformed multi‑legged spider body grants you Night Vision, immunity to Poison, and the ability to step up one block and freely climb vertical surfaces.
You are not hindered by cobwebs; you can climb them and sense entities caught in them.
Spiders do not regard you as an enemy.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.spider_undead.co:
Your maximum health is reduced to 12.
When you have no summons, your movement speed is increased by 40%, but you deal 25% less damage and take 25% more damage.
Your multi‑legged body is ill‑suited for sustained endurance actions—your movement and sprint speed are greatly reduced, and you can no longer jump straight up a full block; instead, you can lunge forward while sprinting.
Your spider digestive system allows you to gain hunger only from externally digested Nutrient Sacs. Additionally, weapons enchanted with Smite deal increased damage to you.
Your chitinous body and bristles are vulnerable to fire—you take increased damage from burning.
You cannot wear chestplates, leggings, or boots; only helmets are possible.
Village Iron Golems treat you as an enemy and will attack you on sight.
item.ssc_xu_addon.undead_essence.tooltip: A concentrated essence of undead power. Holding it in your offhand can prevent one fatal blow.
Can be found in Nether Fortresses.
message.ssc_xu_addon.item.undead_essence: The Undead Essence resonates with your form, transforming you into a new shape.
item.ssc_xu_addon.swarmbond_amulet.toolt: Automatically summons 1 small spider every 15 seconds (max 2). Without any summons, you lose 1 HP per second.
Increases max health to 16 (8 hearts) and reduces damage transfer multiplier to 1.
item.ssc_xu_addon.undead_ring.tooltip.1: [Spider (Undead Matriarch) Form] Zombies and skeletons remain neutral toward you, but you burn in sunlight.
item.ssc_xu_addon.undead_ring.tooltip.2: [Anubis Wolf (Soul Shepherd) Form] Your summoned wolves become Soul Wolves: fixed soul bonus, doubled lifetime, natural regeneration, and teleport back to you when out of range.
item.ssc_xu_addon.shield_ring.tooltip: A ring made with the energy of Earth Gems, capable of forming a shield to block damage.
item.ssc_xu_addon.shield_ring.tooltip2: Cannot regenerate shield for 15 seconds after it is consumed.
item.ssc_xu_addon.form_store_stone.toolt: Right-click to swap forms with the Transmutation Stone: When empty, stores your current form. When full, grants its stored form.
codex.form.ssc_xu_addon.anubis_wolf_soul:
The soul power within the Undead Essence surges into your body, and the souls of the pack reforge their pact with you.
You rise to a standing posture, and the power of souls leaves its mark upon you in gold and lapis lazuli.

Your body has regained an upright posture, though your legs retain the structure of a wolf's hind legs—the power of souls could not fully reshape them.
Golden bands encircle your upper arms, forearms and lower legs, inlaid with lapis lazuli that flickers with the flow of souls.
Your face retains the outline of a jackal, and the golden tufts behind your ears are longer than before. The light of souls reflects in your eyes.
Even at rest, you can feel the souls of the pack whispering within you, awaiting your command.

You have gained the power to command souls—
You possess a Soul resource bar ranging from -6 to 12. Positive Soul enhances your damage and lifesteal; negative Soul weakens your attributes.
The more Soul you hold, the richer your spoils: at 3/6/9/12/15 Soul you gain 1 level of Looting each, up to Looting 5.
Press Active Ability (1) to summon soul wolves; the number depends on your current Soul. Right-click a wolf to spend Soul and raise its level.
Press Active Ability (2) to unleash Judgment: burn your health to damage nearby targets based on their max health, your own Soul, and the distance between them and you.
When your Soul is at least 0, fatal damage triggers Undying: health is restored to 10 and 6 Soul is consumed. Undying cannot trigger while your Soul is depleted.
While sneaking, your summoned wolves show green, blue, purple or gold outlines based on their level.

You are bonded to the souls of the pack: wild wolves in deserts will not attack you.
You can eat bones, are immune to Hunger and Poison, and gain more saturation from rotten flesh.
You always possess Soul Speed, and skeletons will avoid you.
Your body is treated as undead.
Your attacks cannot harm your own summons.
Instant Damage heals you instead.

The power of souls comes at a price—
While your Soul is negative, each point reduces attack damage, attack speed and movement speed, and increases hunger consumption.
Vegetarian food provides less saturation, and health regeneration from saturation is slower.
The undead power lingering in your body still taints your touch: meat dropped from your kills may rot into rotten flesh, and harvested crops may turn to sand.
Even though your body has risen from four legs to an upright posture, your leg structure still prevents you from wearing leggings or boots.
ssc_perk.ssc_xu_addon.anubis_wolf_soulke:
By attuning to souls, you can hold more soul fragments
[Soul cap +1]

Your command over souls deepens
[Soul cap +1]

[Soul cap +1]

[Soul cap +1]

Your wolves absorb drifting soul fragments when they kill
[Each kill has a 20% chance to raise its own level by 1; at most once per kill]
